title: Safety
seoDescription: Safety practices and qualifications at Schnurr Painting.

hero.title: Safe work is planned work.
hero.intro: A commercial painting partner has to protect people, schedules, and the jobsite—not just the finish.

sections.title: Safety is part of the work plan.
sections.copy: Safe execution starts before crews arrive on site and continues through daily coordination, site conditions, and closeout.

sections.title: Experienced commercial crews.
sections.copy: Training, supervision, and jobsite discipline help Schnurr work effectively around other trades and active environments.

sections.title: Qualifications that support larger work.
sections.copy: EMR performance, insurance, OSHA-focused practices, and bonding capacity help support demanding commercial project requirements.
